title: Weekly Consolidation Run and Two-Ledger Reconciliation of Personal Sender Account Statements
content:
For a statement requested on a Personal Sender Account, the consolidation step counts the delivery methods, of Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup and Mobile Wallet, that carry at least one payout in the 12 months before the request date (an entry dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting): a Bank Deposit payout sent, a Cash Pickup payout made, or a Mobile Wallet credit sent.

1. When all 3 of them carry one, the statement goes to the weekly consolidation run, and the statement delivery window is the counted statement window rounded up to the next whole multiple of 5 business days; a counted statement window that already is such a multiple stays as it is.
2. When exactly 2 of them carry one, the statement is reconciled across two ledgers, and the statement delivery window is the counted statement window plus half of it, that half rounded up to a whole business day.
3. When one or none carries one, the statement delivery window is the counted statement window.

The counted statement window is the statement's delivery window in Paloma business days as counted before this step; the step acts on that whole figure once.

## Worked figures (hypothetical counted statement windows)

| Counted statement window | All 3 methods with a payout | Exactly 2 methods | 1 or 0 methods |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 5 | 2 plus 1, that is 3 | 2 |
| 4 | 5 | 4 plus 2, that is 6 | 4 |
| 5 | 5 | 5 plus 3, that is 8 | 5 |
| 7 | 10 | 7 plus 4, that is 11 | 7 |

Half of 5 is two and a half, rounded up to 3; half of 7 is three and a half, rounded up to 4.

## Hypothetical case

A customer whose transfers in the 12 months were paid out by Bank Deposit and credited to a Mobile Wallet, with no Cash Pickup payout made, has 2 delivery methods carrying a payout; the statement is reconciled across two ledgers.
